en.headline: Transport Department sets Huanggang bus and taxi plans
en.dek: The rebuilt crossing will run around the clock, with seven franchised bus routes, a public-transport buffer and a ticket system for taxis.
body: The Transport Department said on Wednesday that the rebuilt Huanggang port, which is due to open soon and will operate 24 hours, is expected to draw heavy passenger flows. The hall will carry public-transport information and service ambassadors to help travellers choose routes.

The department said the port will have seven franchised bus routes, six green-minibus routes and five short-haul cross-boundary bus routes running 24 hours, serving Hong Kong Island, Kowloon and the New Territories. The franchised buses will pass nine MTR stations and four bus interchanges. A dedicated public-transport lane from Fanling Highway and San Tin Highway to San Sham Road will let franchised buses, green minibuses and cross-boundary buses reach the new port without using the San Tin Interchange.

Spare drivers and vehicles will be held in a public-transport buffer near the old port building. The department said a standby bus parked there can reach the pick-up area in about two minutes at peak return times, and operators can also run short-working trips. Empty urban and New Territories taxis, and fleet-taxi drivers with a booked trip, must take a ticket at the buffer before going in turn to the taxi stand or the fleet-taxi boarding area. A waiting area inside the building will have a service counter and an arrival display.

The department said the opening period is likely to be busy and asked people not to rush to the new crossing if another land or rail port suits their trip. It said it has drawn up contingency plans with Shenzhen and Hong Kong port departments and with operators, and urged travellers to leave extra time while they get used to the new arrangements.

zh.headline: 運輸署交代新皇崗口岸巴士及的士安排
zh.dek: 重建口岸將24小時運作，設7條專營巴士線及公交緩衝區。空載的士須先取籌，後備巴士約兩分鐘可到上客區。
body: 運輸署周三表示，重建後的皇崗口岸即將開通，並會24小時運作，預計人流較高。口岸大堂除公共交通資訊外，亦會有服務大使協助旅客揀選路線。署方說已為不同情況作出預案。
署方表示，口岸會有7條專營巴士、6條專線小巴及5條24小時短途跨境巴士路線，直達港九新界。專營巴士途經9個港鐵站及4個巴士轉車站。署方已增設由粉嶺公路及新田公路直達新深路的公共運輸專用車道，專營巴士、專線小巴及跨境巴士毋須經新田交匯處便可前往新口岸。
舊口岸大樓附近設公共交通緩衝區，供營辦商停泊後備車輛。署方稱，回港高峰時停在緩衝區的後備巴士約兩分鐘可到達接載乘客，巴士公司亦可開特別短途班次。空載市區及新界的士，以及已有預約行程的車隊的士司機，須先在緩衝區取籌，再按序前往的士站或車隊的士上客區。口岸大樓內設預約車隊的士候車區，並有服務站及到站顯示屏。
運輸署表示，開通初期會較繁忙，呼籲市民按需要使用其他陸路及鐵路口岸，不必急於使用新口岸，並應提早計劃及預留時間。署方已聯同深港口岸部門及公共運輸營辦商製訂應變方案。
